svg.title: SEO report example — northwind-outdoors.com
svg.desc: Filled one-page SEO report for northwind-outdoors.com, September 2026: 18.4k clicks (+15% vs Aug), clicks trend, top pages, keyword wins, work completed and next steps. Sample data.
svg.text: Clicks up 15% month over month, led by the relaunched category pages.
Relaunched six category pages with buying-guide copy and

Published three guides: tent sizes, layering, checklist
Rewrite titles on page-one queries with CTR under 2%
Roll the category template out to /stoves/ and /lighting/
Link every guide to its matching category page
Sample data, fictional site · Template: whizgraphs.com/seo-report-template/
